description: B-936 A/B CONTROL: --debug-rom-modeldef loads the ORIGINAL N64 ROM modeldefs (baked DL: 2-cycle, G_LIGHTING on, fog+prim combine, lit normals) for the CI-menu world models instead of our custom generated-mesh modeldefs. Room hidden (--debug-hide-scene) so the fast3d world models (Joanna + desk PC + furniture) show against a bare framebuffer. If they render BRIGHT/correct here but DARK via the generated path (main_menu_joanna_textured), the disconnect is isolated to our custom .pdmesh extract/consume -- and the divergence (no G_LIGHTING + 1-cycle + MODULATEIA-on-Col-table-shade vs original 2-cycle + lit + fog/prim) is the bug.
